kind: automated keyboard-only pass in Chromium against the real UI2 shell with a mocked native layer
not_covered: a screen reader (NVDA, Narrator or JAWS) reading the page and dialogs
the packaged app in real WebView2 (focus rings, IME, high-DPI, Windows high contrast)
the owner's own keyboard-only walk-through (owner gate)

checks.title: Tab reaches the sharing switch, Create access, Choose chats, Revoke, Register and the Advanced disclosure
Every tab stop has an accessible name
Every tab stop shows a visible focus indicator
No uncaught page errors during the tab walk
Focus stays on the sharing switch after it is toggled from the keyboard
Space toggles the sharing switch both ways, state exposed via aria-checked
Create access and Copy work with Enter; the one-time key has an accessible name
Without a clipboard, Copy is disabled, a hint explains manual copy, and nothing says Copied
Choose chats: focus moves into the dialog, Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside, Escape closes it, focus returns to the opener
Inline revoke opens from the keyboard, Cancel closes it without revoking, and focus is never dropped to the page body

checks.title: Confirming revoke from the keyboard moves the app to Revoked apps and focus is not lost
The Advanced disclosure opens and closes with Enter and Space, and the hosted consent is a labelled switch
EN to ID by keyboard swaps the page copy without losing focus
At 390px width there is no horizontal scrolling
Controls smaller than 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 target-size minimum; the spacing exception was not evaluated)
